reason: Two browser runs reach the same improved half-star checkpoint at step 200, fail only short self-clearance, and record no repair. A preceding run repaired that checkpoint and returned a lower-error star. The existing 50 ms repair gate is a candidate explanation; saved reports have no checkpoint timestamps.
method: Three fresh control/instrumented pairs per case (18 fits), alternating order, on captured native masks with actual settings and candidate observers. Load-hook instrumentation records per-refinement time allowance, checkpoint time remaining, proposal validity, repair eligibility and selected output. It does not change deadlines, forces, geometry rules or masks.
instrumentationLimit: Taking timestamps and storing small records adds overhead. This is a diagnostic of which branch was taken, not a latency benchmark or a claim that instrumentation reproduces an uninstrumented trajectory.
acceptance: Establish whether the missing repair was time-gated before designing a change. Any later change must preserve legality, features and total search budget, and demonstrate improved final source-mask error rather than only a better unvalidated checkpoint.
dependency: tmp/heart-learning/gradient-bins-runtime-v1/qa/state.json must be complete; the runner asserts this before fitting.

photo-gift.evidence: Both arms select 4+4 cuts and enter polish with identical checkpoint errors at steps 0, 40 and 80. The losing 5+5 alternative receives more time in the candidate arm, and the selected 4+4 trajectory stops earlier during polishing. This identifies budget allocation as a concrete source of the final discrepancy; repeated instrumentation will check the deadlines.
photo-gift.visualReview: Both independent renders inspected: motif is retained; thin seams and uneven frame edges remain. The 80 additional wrong pixels are not treated as unchanged quality.

photo-warped-checker.evidence: Both arms select 9+9 cuts. The candidate enters polishing with a worse checkpoint, so the difference occurs before the final polishing cutoff. Per-refinement timing is needed to identify that earlier divergence.
photo-warped-checker.visualReview: Both independent renders inspected: motif structure is retained with small boundary and central-join differences; 40 additional wrong pixels are retained in the comparison.
